Level 2 - Beginner 30 min Design principles Machine coding

DRY, KISS, YAGNI & Law of Demeter

Four short rules that decide whether a reviewer calls your code "clean" or "over-engineered": keep each piece of knowledge in one place, prefer the simple design, do not build what nobody asked for, and talk only to your direct friends. Each with before/after code, where they fight each other, and how to use them in a machine-coding round.
